title: Narrow string erase
summary: Recovered Game.exe VA 0x416660, 155 bytes, as a genuine thiscall member method with two uint32_t arguments and pointer return. The 24-byte i386 object contains a 16-byte inline/pointer union, size at +16, capacity at +20. Capacity >=16 selects heap. Unsigned offset validation precedes all writes; deletion clamps to the suffix, or shifts the surviving tail left excluding the terminator, publishes the new size and writes one NUL. Interior count-zero calls preserve every byte; end-position count-zero calls write a terminator. No allocation or capacity change. Callers inspected include self-substring assignment at 0x416034/0x41604d and one-character graphics-options erasure at 0x4a289f. Original instructions, imports and error literal were inspected directly in Game.exe; accepted assembly was independently compared equal for all 155 bytes. No matching-source claim.
test_description: Fixed-flag GCC i386 freestanding build with -Wall -Wextra -Werror passes. Enumerates capacities 0,15,16,31,63, lengths 0..15 inline and 0..63 heap, all valid offsets, counts 0..length+1 and UINT_MAX. Inputs contain embedded NULs, nonzero old terminators, poisoned storage, heap margins and object canaries. Compares return identity, complete object bytes, capacity, pointer, unused union bytes, full backing arrays and independent expected outputs. Invalid offsets length+1 and UINT_MAX test nonreturning error dispatch, message and unchanged object. Local linker places accepted oracle at 0x416660 and test-only .oracle_iat at 0x92d16c; intercepted cdecl memmove and out-of-range imports permit direct original comparisons for every case. This mapped execution passes. A second unmapped execution also passes and explicitly reports that original shift/error paths require import mapping; it directly compares original suffix/no-op paths and retains independent recovered shift/error assertions. Original reference bytes equal immutable Game.exe. Optional /tools/msvc/msvc was absent.
known_limits: Original std::_Xout_of_range exception construction and Windows unwinding are external dependencies. The port supplies narrow_out_of_range, which must never return; tests use GCC builtin nonlocal transfer. No invented returning-error behavior is provided.

Full original shift/error differential execution requires .oracle_iat linked at 0x92d16c (207 four-byte slots; memmove at index 206). Local full execution passed with this mapping. The trusted harness is not assumed to provide it: submitted tests detect its absence and report reduced original-path execution explicitly.

Original imported memmove is intercepted with a forward-copy implementation appropriate to the strictly leftward overlap produced by erase. General CRT memmove behavior and Windows runtime internals are outside the assigned scope.

Invalid storage pointers, corrupt object metadata and impossible buffer extents are not given portable behavior. Tests intentionally vary storage-selector metadata with adequately backed buffers, but cannot exhaust all uint32_t lengths.

Object ABI is original i386 layout. Native 64-bit ports must adapt pointer layout deliberately. Implementation uses C++11-compatible syntax and compiler-guarded thiscall declarations; native MSVC2013 compilation was not available locally and remains a coordinator check.
